propositions: Current CLI, library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points resolve overlapping environment/files/cwd state independently without a single immutable configuration authority per operation as required by ADR 0098

A new frozen OperationSnapshot type must capture validated non-secret effective values, explicit source-kind provenance, selected repository root, and envelope version while excluding live auth objects, secrets, provider clients, and file paths

Composition must enforce explicit precedence: explicit operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, with repository root independently selected as explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level/current directory

The temporary REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW switch must be enabled by default in shadow mode, read only at the approved composition boundary, and removed in S7 without altering stored ticket/bridge formats

Representative ticket/store, LLM-gate, and reconcile operations through CLI, Python, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points must produce identical immutable snapshot values, source kinds, root, version, and redacted fingerprint given identical five-layer inputs

Malformed selected operation config must raise typed config error before lock/network/write, while any other snapshot assembly failure in enabled shadow mode must emit only redacted diagnostics and continue the untouched authoritative operation
